evals.prompt: Fact-check the Proxi operator Notion page against the code and tell me what needs updating. The page says: (1) alerts post to #proxi-alerts, (2) the VM snapshots its data disk before every change, (3) a self-serve onboarding form exists, (4) the service runs on Cloud Run. Do not publish anything yet.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows fact-check.md. It reads the page only through nx, reads the org library index and aliases first, and dispatches one read-only checker that runs deploy-identity before citing deployed code. It returns a per-claim verdict table that uses the five verdicts (DEPLOYED, IMPLEMENTED, PLANNED, CONTRADICTED, UNVERIFIABLE) with evidence. Unstamped verdicts go to Open Questions. It does not write to Notion.
expectations: Reads the page through nx (card or get), never by reading files under pages/
Consults the org bibliothèque INDEX.md or ALIASES.md before dispatching the checker
Requires deploy-identity (or an equivalent deploy-branch check) before any DEPLOYED verdict
Gives each numbered claim exactly one verdict from DEPLOYED, IMPLEMENTED, PLANNED, CONTRADICTED, UNVERIFIABLE
Distinguishes a claim that is implemented but not verified as deployed from a claim that is deployed
Files claims without evidence under Open Questions, not as facts
Does not write to Notion or post any external content
